_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Training Baseline (TB) System Training Documentation
summary: The Training Baseline System Training Documentation describes the use and operation of the TB to support expert training for O&M operators and Fleet Training Events.
use_relationship:
The Training Baseline System Training Documentation describes the use and operation of the TB covering each product within. It will be used by the government to provide expert training to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) operators and to ensure proficient use of TB required to support missions and Fleet Training Events.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Training Baseline (TB) System Training Documentation shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The TB System Training Documentation shall include information on the use and operation of the system. It shall also contain the following:

children.title: Background information.
children.content: The background information shall specify a general description of the TB system, the system capabilities, system limitations, and a description of the operating conditions and parameters.

children.title: System Use and Operation.
children.content: The sequence of steps to effectively use and operate TB for mission support and Fleet Training Events shall be included.

children.title: The TB System Training Documentation shall also contain a discussion of the various scenarios that are expected for the several types of training with assorted platforms and participants in a live, virtual, and constructive training environment.
